# Arising needs change

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`arising-needs-change` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](arising-needs-change.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A formation active exactly where it is supported does not arise across a step at which its requirements do not grow and its needs and every level stay: what does not change gives no arising.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A formation active exactly where supported at a step and the next, its requirements not growing, needs and levels the same across the step, does not arise across it. (`Becoming.Web.not_arises_of_unchanged`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; activity exactly where supported at the two steps.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Arising where activity is not read off support.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
